summary: Tested payslip Edit, Delete, and Regenerate functionality. All 3 new features are working correctly. Backend APIs (DELETE, PUT /edit, POST /regenerate) return correct responses. Frontend UI shows Edit/Delete/Regenerate buttons for draft/operations_review/ceo_review status payslips, and only Download PDF/Regenerate for generated payslips.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/9 tests passed, 1 skipped due to no finalized payslip available)

seed_data_creation: Created test payslip for Swathi (April 2026) to test Edit/Delete/Regenerate buttons
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payslip Edit/Delete/Regenerate features fully tested. Edit button opens modal with HR Remarks textarea. Delete button shows confirmation dialog. Regenerate recalculates payslip from latest data. Buttons have data-testid attributes: edit-payslip-btn, delete-payslip-btn, regenerate-payslip-btn. Generated payslips only show Download PDF and Regenerate (no Edit/Delete).

backend_delete_endpoint.details: Returns 200 with success message for draft/operations_review/ceo_review payslips. Returns 400 for finalized payslips. Returns 404 for non-existent payslips.

backend_edit_endpoint.details: Updates hr_remarks field. Returns 400 for invalid fields (net_salary, etc). Returns 404 for non-existent payslips.

backend_regenerate_endpoint.details: Recalculates payslip from latest attendance/salary data. Resets status to draft. Returns 404 for non-existent payslips.

frontend_edit_button_visibility.details: Edit button visible for draft/operations_review/ceo_review status payslips. Has data-testid='edit-payslip-btn'.

frontend_delete_button_visibility.details: Delete button visible for draft/operations_review/ceo_review status payslips. Has data-testid='delete-payslip-btn'.

frontend_regenerate_button_visibility.details: Regenerate button visible for all payslip statuses. Has data-testid='regenerate-payslip-btn' for non-finalized, data-testid='regenerate-generated-payslip-btn' for generated.

frontend_edit_modal.details: Edit button opens modal with title 'Edit Payslip', HR Remarks textarea, Cancel and Save Changes buttons.

frontend_delete_confirmation.details: Delete button opens confirmation dialog with message 'Are you sure you want to delete this payslip for {month} {year}? This action cannot be undone.' with Cancel and Delete Payslip buttons.

frontend_generated_payslip_buttons.details: Generated payslips only show Download PDF and Regenerate buttons (no Edit/Delete).
